title: codex
intro: OpenAI's Codex CLI, headless over `codex exec --json`, on any provider that speaks the OpenAI Responses API. The thread id from the first turn is kept in `$HI_DIR` and later turns run `codex exec resume <id>`.
notes: Codex reads its provider from `$CODEX_HOME/config.toml`, written every turn: `model_providers.hi` with the gateway's `/v1` base and `env_key = "OPENAI_API_KEY"`, which `provider_env` sets to the session token.
`sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"` and `--skip-git-repo-check`: the container is the sandbox and the workspace need not be a git repository.
The three `features` switches stop Codex cloning its plugin repository and discovering models over the network, both of which the door would refuse anyway.
The request's model path (`node22/codex/openai-responses/<model>`) picks the model; `gpt-5.4-mini` is the default here.
